tools.name: selah_rate_benchmark
tools.description: What should a creator charge for a sponsored post or brand deal? Give the deliverable and the creator's audience size (and, if the brand asks for them, usage rights, exclusivity or rush) and get Selah's rate, the range published creator-rate guides give for the same thing, the add-ons priced on top,

tools.name: selah_check_offer
tools.description: Is this brand offer fair? Give what the brand wants (deliverable, the creator's audience size, any usage rights, exclusivity or rush) and the amount they offered, and get where the offer sits against Selah's rate for that whole scope, how it compares with published rates, and a suggested counter-off

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: selah_rate_benchmark, selah_check_offer · Public sink: selah_rate_benchmark.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: selah_rate_benchmark, selah_check_offer · Public sink: selah_rate_benchmark

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
